factor_name: Downside-volatility inverse 10-day reversal with dispersion gate

calculation.expression: rank_cs(clip10_90(-log(close/close[-10]) / downside_vol_20)) - 0.5, multiplied by percentile_rank_60(mean_cross_asset(realized_vol_5)), then rolling_mean_5
calculation.description: Ranks inverse downside-volatility-scaled ten-session reversal, clips cross-sectional extremes, and increases signal amplitude in high aggregate cross-asset dispersion regimes. All rolling inputs are lag-safe at the decision date.

validation.regime_notes: Passed benchmark gates of absolute IC >= 0.0070 and absolute ICIR >= 0.0840. Small cross-asset sample and incomplete overlapping histories imply conservative uncertainty; long-window ICIR is supported by 1,780 dates but recent performance is materially stronger than the full sample.
